knowledge_base.content: Yajie holds nine badges on Credly: Google UX Design, Google Cybersecurity and Google AI Essentials; AWS Cloud Quest: Cloud Practitioner, plus AWS Educate Machine Learning Foundations, Introduction to Generative AI and Machine Learning (DeepRacer); and Red Hat Introduction to OpenShift AI and Application Development I: Java EE. He also completed DataCamp's AI & Python.

Yajie works across AI and prompt engineering, machine learning, data science, UI/UX design, web development, graphic design and video editing. He codes in Python and JavaScript, and designs in Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro.

Yajie can help with machine learning and AI tools, data science and analytics, UI/UX design, web development, graphic design and brand visuals, and video editing. The contact form is the quickest way to start a project.
